name: observatorio-gastos-publicos
description: Plataforma de análise de gastos públicos municipais brasileiros

scripts.start: docker compose up -d --build --remove-orphans && docker compose ps
scripts.rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d --force-recreate --remove-orphans && docker compose ps
scripts.health: docker compose exec backend wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3001/health
scripts.doctor: docker compose ps && docker compose exec backend getent hosts db && docker compose exec backend nc -zv db 5432 && docker compose exec backend getent hosts redis && docker compose exec backend nc -zv redis 6379 && docker compose exec db pg_isready -U observatorio -d observatorio && docker compose exec redis redis-cli ping
scripts.shell:db: docker compose exec db psql -U observatorio -d observatorio
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend node dist/database/seed.js
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
